title: Comfortable for one large human or two lighter humans
text: Comfortable for one large human or two lighter humans. I finally put this together a couple months after receiving... so too late to return even though I bought it because it was advertised as holding up to two people, and it is not going to work that way for us. Included paperwork specifies up to 275 lbs max... I googled the average adult weight which is 137.5 lbs, so I suppose technically this does hold up to two "exactly average" adults, a few children, or one skinny and one not-so skinny adult.  It won't hold two adults in my household. However, it is very comfortable, and although I was sagging close to the bar when initially setting it up with the last links on the chains on the hook. I adjusted it so the chains are connected to the hooks more at the center links, and that raised it up. But I am curious how well it would support the 275 lb max, without bringing it back down to the bar.
